entries.description: Read docs/planning/project-guidance.md and docs/planning/lessons-learned.md. Confirmed UAT Review Session (set type) procedure: classify every finding Blocker/Substantive/Minor/Out-of-scope, output either stub-spec / micro-fix / signoff, commit disposition artifact, queue next action. Orchestrator guidance: fits Sonnet cleanly; Opus only when ambiguous.

Parsed docs/session-sets/security-dashboard-uat-remediation/security-dashboard-uat-remediation-uat-checklist.json (54 Review items). Distribution: 26 pass-clean, 1 pass-judgment-with-rationale (#32 DisplayAlias width), 10 substantive findings (fail or non-empty feedback), 17 empty Other auto-rows treated as non-findings.
Routed classification of 10 substantive UAT findings via route(task_type=analysis). Model: gemini-pro. Tokens in/out: 2102/940. Raw output saved to session-reviews/classification-round1.md.

Wrote disposition.md summarizing all 10 findings with severity/disposition/rationale; 2 Blockers [2][11], 2 Minor [14][49], 6 Out-of-scope [8][9][20][33][34][35]. Also captured the non-findings count (17 empty Other + 26 pass-clean + 1 judgment).

Created stub spec for the next set `security-dashboard-uat-followup-fixes` at docs/session-sets/security-dashboard-uat-followup-fixes/spec.md. 1-session set covering the 4 actionable findings (2 Blocker + 2 Minor). Inserted into the roadmap ahead of Set D since the two Blockers are regressions against deliverables Set D plugs into.

dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln: 0 errors, 184 warnings (all pre-existing [Obsolete] warnings on RoleSwitching types scheduled for removal in Set C). dotnet test (non-Playwright): 661 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. Skipped Playwright (Docker) since this session touched no product code.
Cross-provider verification via route(task_type=session-verification, complexity_hint=70). Model: opus. Tokens in/out: 8314/5804. Raw verdict saved to session-reviews/session-001.md.

Generated change-log.md directly (not routed) since the orchestrator is Opus and the task is a narrative summary of a 1-session UAT Review. Records classification stats, verification verdict, and cost summary.

Committed (f6327ba) and pushed. 8 files changed, 819 insertions. Staged only the two new session-set folders + the router-metrics.jsonl updates from this session; left the human's pre-existing modified files (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md/README.md/docker/Dockerfile.Playwright/security-config.json/user-roles.json/etc.) untouched for their own commit flow.

Step 9 reorganization review: proposed 2 collapse-to-reference candidates in lessons-learned.md (UAT Checklist Files Must Match The Editor Contract; Pending Human UAT Must Be Called Out Explicitly) -- both already fully captured in project-guidance Conventions + applied as the right call across 3+ session sets plus this UAT Review.
